title: Mystica 3 Cartridge Battery
description:
The Airis Mystica III is an ultra-slim, compact and portable oil cartridge battery designed with universal 510 thread port, versatile adjustable voltage output options and a premium solid metal construction that looks sleek and is quite durable.

It’s wide atomizer port is designed to fit most oil/wax cartridges on the market measuring up to and including 12mm wide. Inside each kit Airistech includes two ultra convenient magnetic adapter rings that attach to your atomizer to instantly create a strong, secure and reliable connection to the battery.

Under the hood, it has a long-lasting 350mAh lithium-ion battery powering your session with the simple touch of a button. Airistech also includes an innovative preheat power mode to help you better heat waxy oils or even to clear a clogged cartridge in a pinch. When needed just double click the button to activate a cycle and it will use a low voltage output to warm your cartridge for up to 15 seconds at a time.

The Mystica V3 Vape is one of the most portable and discreet oil cartridges on the market that is absolutely packed with features to make your experience unbeatable. Grab yours today in your choice of 7 sleek colors.

Features

- Newest Mystica Vape with Premium Metal Body

- Ultra Lightweight and Portable Size

- Premium 350mAh Lithium-ion Battery

- Recharges via USB in Only 1-2 Hours

- Adjustable Voltage Power Output (3.4-4.2V)

- Cutting-edge Low Output Preheat Mode

- 10 Second Heating Duration / 15 Second Preheat Duration

- Universal 510 Thread Port: Fits Up to 12mm Wide

- Set Includes 2 Convenient Magnetic Ring Adapters

- User-Friendly Atomizer Oil Viewing Window

- Easy to Use One Button Operation with LED Indicator

Includes:

- 1 x Mystica III Vaporizer

- 2 x Magnetic Ring Adapter

- 1 x USB Charging Cable

- 1 x User Manual
